summary: Rank One Computing Corp filed an 8-K reporting that certain executive officers voluntarily agreed to extend their IPO-related lock-up restrictions for an additional six months until February 23, 2027. The lock-up holders collectively own approximately 54% of total outstanding shares and 66% of non-publicly traded shares. The agreements were entered into on August 19, 2026, and a form of agreement is filed as Exhibit 10.1. This is a routine corporate governance matter, not a special situation. No transaction, price, premium, or deal terms are involved. The extension reduces potential selling overhang post-IPO, but no risk-arb angle applies; monitor for any future insider selling after the lock-up expiry.
